reference: He had already grated the cheese when she threw the basil in.
sk: Syr už mal nastrúhaný, keď ona pridala bazalku.
cz: Sýr už měl nastrouhaný, když ona přidala bazalku.
acceptable: He had already grated the cheese when she {threw the basil in|threw in the basil|added the basil|put the basil in|put in the basil|tossed the basil in|tossed in the basil}.
When she {threw the basil in|threw in the basil|added the basil|put the basil in|put in the basil|tossed the basil in|tossed in the basil}, he had already grated the cheese.

mistakes.text: He had already grated the cheese when she had thrown the basil in.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Bazalka prišla až po strúhaní, preto Past Simple: „threw“. Past Perfect patrí k skoršiemu deju.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Bazalka přišla až po strouhání, proto Past Simple: „threw“. Past Perfect patří k dřívějšímu ději.
mistakes.feedback_en: The basil went in later, so use Past Simple “threw”; Past Perfect is for the earlier action.

mistakes.text: He had already grated the cheese when she throwed the basil in.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Throw“ je nepravidelné sloveso, Past Simple je „threw“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Throw“ je nepravidelné sloveso, Past Simple je „threw“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Throw” is irregular: its Past Simple is “threw”.

mistakes.text: He already grated the cheese when she {threw the basil in|added the basil}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Strúhanie sa skončilo pred pridaním bazalky, preto Past Perfect: „had already grated“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Strouhání skončilo před přidáním bazalky, proto Past Perfect: „had already grated“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The grating was finished before the basil went in, so use Past Perfect: “had already grated”.

mistakes.text: He had already grated the cheese when she was throwing the basil in.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Hodenie bazalky je krátky ukončený dej, preto je prirodzenejší Past Simple: „threw“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Hození bazalky je krátký ukončený děj, proto je přirozenější Past Simple: „threw“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Throwing the basil in is a short, finished action, so Past Simple “threw” fits better.

mistakes.text: He had already grated the cheese when she {throw|throws} the basil in.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej sa odohral v minulosti, preto Past Simple: „threw“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj se odehrál v minulosti, proto Past Simple: „threw“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action happened in the past, so use Past Simple: “threw”.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'pridala bazalku' (added the basil); 'added the basil' accepted alongside 'threw the basil in'.
